rootCause: LocalCpfFileTransferAdapterTest constructs its engine-level request without checksum or physical size even though the canonical runtime policy is fail-closed with checksumRequired=true. The direct adapter can calculate a result checksum, but the engine must validate its request before dispatch.
requiredFix: Currentize the test request factory to provide the actual SHA-256 and byte size, preserving the strict production policy, then rerun the complete affected module set.

sourceFix.testInput: Reads the physical source bytes once, supplies their SHA-256 and exact length.

verification: Complete SFTP suite PASS 20/20 with zero failures/errors/skips in the affected-module regression.
